thread:
Sam L.: FYI procurement blocked an AWS Marketplace PO because the PO payload uses a different cost_center (RDW-SALES) than our ERP mapping (RDW-PLATFORM). PO# AWS-2026-8899.
Priya C.: Oof. Is this reseller or direct?
Sam L.: Reseller flow (acct acct-0217). Vendor says marketplace payload is immutable on their side.
Taylor N.: That means our ingest job rejects it. Procure needs a matching invoice -> payment. What's the quick unblock?
Marco R.: We can create a temporary alias mapping in the billing/ingest layer (treat RDW-SALES as RDW-PLATFORM). Not ideal long-term but works.
Ana P.: Finance can approve a one-off mapping if Legal documents it and we attach required compliance artifacts. Need SOC2 or equivalent and a logged approval.
Sam L.: SOC2 uploaded to contract folder: https://files.redwood/soc2-2025.pdf. Procurement wants link on the PO record.
legal-bot: automated-check: altering PO acceptance behavior triggers marketplace T&C review. Case opened: LR-3201.
Riya (Legal): OK to approve a temporary alias for 21 days with explicit expiration and note LR-3201 on the PO. It must be clearly marked as operational only and not change revenue/legal entity mapping.
Priya C.: Proposed command for ops: `erp_alias add "AWS:acct-0217:RDW-SALES"=RDW-PLATFORM --expires 2026-05-15 --ticket LR-3201`
Taylor N.: I'll add the SOC2 link and LR-3201 to the PO and ping procurement to re-run ingestion after alias creation.
Ana P.: Once alias exists + SOC2 attached, we can mark ready-for-payment and run a manual ingest. Need contact person for audit trail on the PO.
Marco R.: Creating alias now, will include audit note referencing marketplace partner, PO# AWS-2026-8899, and LR-3201.
Sam L.: Thanks. Quick check: will analytics/cost-reports break because of the alias? We need alias mapping reflected in exports.
Riya (Legal): From legal perspective it's fine. Finance should confirm accounting downstream but this is a temporary operational alias only. Capture in contract notes and this Slack thread. :thumbsup:
Priya C.: Noted. Tagging @analytics to sync alias into cost exports.
Taylor N.: SOC2 attached, procurement notified. I'll follow up if manual ingest fails.
Ana P.: Confirmed 90min ETA to re-run ingest after alias creation.
Sam L.: Will coordinate with vendor onboarding for a permanent fix. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
